ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition and Advertising majors on Monday, April 21, 2014 and to business minors on Monday, April 28, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This section will open to Technical Systems Management, French Commerical and Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering students on Monday, May 5, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 29, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
